description:
# Romania Economic Indicators

A structured collection of Romanian economic indicators, compiled and normalized by **eCifre** using data published by official Romanian and European institutions.

The dataset includes historical time series covering GDP and economic growth, inflation, wages, employment and unemployment, exchange rates, public finance, construction, energy, and county-level (regional) indicators for Romania. Interactive charts, current values, methodology and additional economic context for every indicator are available at **https://ecifre.ro**.

## Sources

Data in this dataset is derived from official institutions actually represented in these files:

- Institutul National de Statistica (INSSE)
- Banca Nationala a Romaniei (BNR)
- Eurostat
- Ministerul Finantelor (MFIN)
- Agentia Nationala pentru Ocuparea Fortei de Munca (ANOFM)
- Autoritatea Nationala de Reglementare in Domeniul Energiei (ANRE) - natural gas market data
- ENTSO-E Transparency Platform - European electricity market data
- Oficiul National al Registrului Comertului (ONRC)

## License note

This dataset combines data from 8 institutions whose own publication terms are not uniform: most Romanian institutions (INSSE, BNR, MFIN, ANOFM, ANRE, ONRC) publish their data as public without stating an explicit open-reuse license; Eurostat's standard reuse policy (Commission Decision 2011/833/EU) and ENTSO-E's publication under EU Regulation 543/2013 both permit free reuse with attribution. Because of this mix, no single standard license (CC0, CC-BY, ODbL, etc.) is asserted here - License is set to "Other" rather than overstating what any one source has granted. If you plan to redistribute this data further, please check the linked source_url for the specific rows you're using.

Attribution is appreciated: **eCifre - Romania Economic Indicators, https://ecifre.ro**

## Citation

This dataset has a permanent, versioned snapshot on Zenodo with a DOI:

**eCifre. Romania Economic Indicators. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22255140**

(concept DOI, always resolves to the latest version — see https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22255141 for the exact 2026.09 snapshot this Kaggle dataset is built from)

## About eCifre

eCifre is a Romanian economic data platform designed to make official Romanian economic indicators, statistics and economy data easier to discover, understand and compare: **https://ecifre.ro**
